sources.heading: Sources and honesty
sources.sub: Every fact in this game comes from a public source. Here's how to check it.
sources.realBody: Photos, the Moon and Mars maps, dates, distances, mission facts, and hardware status are taken from NASA, JPL, and USGS.
sources.simplifiedBody: Echo and Archive Control are fictional. The 3D hardware is hand-built and stylized. Landing, driving, orbit, and battery simulations use real physics ideas with shortened distances and times. Landing-site puzzles and soil charts are illustrations, not data.
sources.date: Facts were checked in November 2026. Missions change, so visit NASA for the latest.
sources.notEndorsed: This is an independent student project. It is not endorsed by NASA.
